headline: SC clears way for Sarwar Alamgir to perform MP duties
summary: The Appellate Division has ruled that there is no barrier for the BNP candidate from Chattogram-2 to attend parliamentary sessions.
details: The Appellate Division of the Supreme Court, led by the Chief Justice, has ruled that Sarwar Alamgir can attend the next parliamentary session without any restrictions.
caption:
The Supreme Court has cleared the way for Sarwar Alamgir to attend parliamentary sessions.

The Appellate Division of the Supreme Court, led by the Chief Justice, has ruled that Sarwar Alamgir can attend the next parliamentary session without any restrictions.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: August election: [[Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir likely candidate for President]]
headline: August election: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir likely candidate for President
summary: The government is planning to hold the presidential election in August, with BNP's Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir emerging as a top contender.
details: The government is considering holding the presidential election in the second or third week of August, according to high-level sources.
The election is expected to take place without waiting for the next session of the National Parliament.
While no official announcement has been made yet, discussions are reportedly underway within the BNP's policy-making levels.
Among several names that were previously discussed, BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir's name is now receiving the most importance.
The move comes as the government seeks to fill the presidential vacancy soon.
caption:
A new President for Bangladesh? The government is planning an August election, and a key BNP leader is in the spotlight.

The government is considering holding the presidential election in the second or third week of August, according to high-level sources.

The election is expected to take place without waiting for the next session of the National Parliament.

While no official announcement has been made yet, discussions are reportedly underway within the BNP's policy-making levels.

Among several names that were previously discussed, BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir's name is now receiving the most importance.

The move comes as the government seeks to fill the presidential vacancy soon.

Source: Prothom Alo
